description: Start a creative task (writing, strategy, naming, ideas, research-backed docs) as a new Nutcracker chat in a space; the space brand memory and pins apply. Returns task_id and the chat url. A task takes minutes: poll get_task until it is no longer running.

brief.description: The outcome you need and who it is for, in plain words.

context.description: Facts, numbers, sources and constraints the work must rest on.

doc_ids.description: Docs, presentations or storyboards the task must read (ids from get_task, list_space or create_doc).

files.description: file_id values from sending files to upload_file urls.

model.description: A name from list_models with kind writer, only when your human named one ("run it on Opus"). Without it the task runs on the workspace default, which suits most work.

name: start_task
title: Start task
